title: The status line drops the token totals before it hides rarely changed settings
body:
The status line under the prompt (`src/header.rs` and `src/ui.rs`) shows the settings on the left and the session's numbers on the right. When the line overflows, the right side drops its least important items first: tokens and cost, then the context count, then the plan. Settings move into `⋯` only after that. With the Claude adapter's six settings, whose labels read `fast mode off · ultracode off · agent default`, a 120-column screen loses the `↑ ↓` totals and the cost once the conversation's scroll bar takes its column. The verification run on 2026-11-09 saw this.

## Proposal

Settings that rarely change (`model_config` and uncategorised ones) move into `⋯` before any number on the right is dropped. Mode, model and thought level stay visible as long as anything else does.
